heading: About CareAlert
intro: We're a student-led team building a small, dependable tool for a big problem: the gap between when something goes wrong and when the right person finds out.

mission.body: CareAlert exists so that no family member, nurse, or caregiver has to find out about an urgent health change too late. We build simple alert tools that connect the person who notices a problem to the person who can act on it — in seconds, not hours. Our work is grounded in conversations with real patients, families, and clinicians, and every feature we ship has to earn its place by making someone's day-to-day care easier.

team.intro: CareAlert is built by an interdisciplinary student team, working alongside clinicians and caregivers.

partners.body: We work with local care facilities, family caregiver networks, and clinical advisors who help us test CareAlert in real settings and keep it grounded in how care actually happens.
